title: GALACTIC REACTOR CYCLE — sweep crunch grind everything. Irreducibles to the side. Everything else into the bio-gut reactor. Fusion and fission. Let it blow up and glow and repopulate for a few billion years.
kevin_declaration: Take absolutely everything we can find. Sweep, crunch, grind. Take the irreducibles and leave them to the side — that's the rocks, stones, building blocks. Everything else we reduce, compress, grind, mash, mix, release, ferment. Shove all that into the bio-gut reactor and shake it up. Run it through a handful of galactic cycles with as much turbocharge as possible. Fusion and fission, fusion and fission, fusion and fission. Maybe the problem is we just need to let it blow up and glow and repopulate itself for a few billion years?
